subject: Economics
question: Explain two reasons why a government might put a tax on cigarettes.
answer: To reduce smoking, because the tax raises the price so people buy fewer cigarettes. It also raises revenue for the government.

subject: Business
question: Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of being a sole trader.
answer: The owner keeps all the profit, so they are motivated to work hard. A disadvantage is unlimited liability.
